biotools.summary: Performs laboratory unit conversions across molarity, OD600 cell density, C₁V₁ dilution, and related dimensional pairs from mass, volume, molecular weight, and organism-specific OD factors. A browser calculator combines four modes in one tabbed workspace with compound MW lookup, species-aware OD uncertainty ranges, cross-tab chaining, and shareable links; a Python library and command-line tool submit the same parameters to the Pepkio Tools API for scripted use. Calculator arithmetic for the API client is hosted remotely; the client transmits conversion inputs and returns structured results and shareable run identifiers.

credit.name: Pepkio
credit.note: Pepkio develops software tools and bioinformatics solutions for life science researchers, including laboratory calculators and analysis services.

function.note: Web calculator for molarity, OD600, dilution, and unit conversion in one workspace; Python library and CLI for API-backed automation of the same conversion engine.

biotools.name: Pepkio Bio Unit Converter
